Nice and simple 😊
They’ve got 30 days from delivery to start a return or exchange. 
They just enter the order number + email/postcode in the returns portal and choose the item. 
They can request an exchange for a different size of the same item. 
A couple of things to keep in mind:
The new item is only sent once the return is scanned in.
If the size is out of stock, they’ll get a refund instead.
Exchanges are sent with standard delivery.
So it’s basically: return it, choose the size, and wait for the replacement 💙
